subject: Clarify: SOC 2 period endpoints and midday/point-in-time inclusion
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@acme-payments.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Teresa Nguyen <t.nguyen@auditorco.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Jan 2026 10:12:00 -0500
Subject: SOC 2 Type II report - exact period inclusivity question

Hi Jordan,

Thanks for sending over the SOC 2 Type II report and the questionnaire. Before we start mapping evidence, our security team has a couple of precise questions about the audit period boundaries so we can scope our tests correctly:

1) Your SOC 2 report cover dates say "July 1, 2025 - December 31, 2025". Does that mean the report includes point-in-time testing performed exactly at 00:00:00 on Dec 31 (and any tests recorded that day), or are months treated as whole inclusively (i.e., anything that happened on Dec 31 at any time should be considered in-scope)?

2) Our compliance policy requires snapshots for the exact end-of-period (end of day UTC). Are you able to provide confirmation that the control evidence (user listings, config snapshots, ACL exports) includes the Dec 31 23:59:59 UTC state, or will the auditor supply separate point-in-time extracts?

3) If there were routine maintenance windows on Dec 31 that caused brief access variance (e.g., service restarts between 02:00-03:00 local), how are those documented in your report/bridge letter?

Also attaching the questionnaire we need populated (Acme_SOC2-Request-questions.xlsx). Can Teresa please confirm what the auditor typically accepts as sufficient point-in-time evidence?

Thanks,
Liam
Security Lead, Acme Payments
[attachment: Acme_SOC2-Request-questions.xlsx]
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@acme-payments.com>
Cc: Teresa Nguyen <t.nguyen@auditorco.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 06 Jan 2026 09:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II report - exact period inclusivity question

Hi Liam —

Appreciate the detailed questions. Short answers up front:
- The period "July 1, 2025 - December 31, 2025" is inclusive of events that occurred anytime on Dec 31, 2025 (all timestamps on that date are in-scope).
- We can provide point-in-time extracts for Dec 31 23:59:59 UTC where available (user lists, ACL snapshots, config exports, and system activity logs).
- For maintenance windows we capture maintenance tickets/change records and include them as exceptions in the report; if needed we can provide a short bridge letter calling out any planned maintenance that impacted the end-of-period.

Teresa — can you confirm auditor expectations for file formats and whether a single "end-of-day" archive is sufficient, or if you prefer separate artifact types (e.g., DB export + config dump + access log slice)?

I've looped in Monica from our compliance team to coordinate the artifacts and timing. We'll aim to send a package and a draft bridge letter by Thursday EOD PT.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Sales Engineering, Redwood Inference
[attachment: Redwood-bridge-letter-template.docx]
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@acme-payments.com>
Date: Tue, 06 Jan 2026 11:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II report - exact period inclusivity question

Jordan / Karthik —

Quick internal notes to draft the final reply and evidence package:

- Evidence types we can produce for Dec 31 23:59:59 UTC:
  • Identity provider user export (CSV) with created/disabled timestamps
  • IAM role bindings and ACL JSON snapshots (stored in S3, freeze snapshot)
  • Infrastructure config dump from Terraform state (versioned)
  • Edge logs and auth logs: we can slice 23:59:00-23:59:59 UTC for the day-end spike window
  • Change/maintenance tickets from Jira with timestamps and approval records

- For maintenance exceptions: we should include the Jira ID, exact UTC window, the rollback note, and a short statement in a bridge letter noting the controls remained effective before/after the window.

- Format: auditors typically accept compressed archives (tar.gz) with a manifest CSV enumerating files + checksums. Teresa, is that acceptable?

Action items:
- Jordan: send the final confirmation to Liam + Teresa with timeline and link to the evidence bundle.
- Karthik: prepare the ACL + IdP export and add checksums to the manifest (ETA Wed 12:00 PT).
- Monica: draft the brief bridge letter calling out maintenance windows and confirming inclusivity.

Monica Patel
Director, Compliance Ops, Redwood Inference
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@acme-payments.com>, Teresa Nguyen <t.nguyen@auditorco.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 07 Jan 2026 15:22:00 -0800
Subject: Final: confirmation of Dec 31 inclusivity and evidence delivery plan

Hi Liam / Teresa —

Following up with the confirmed plan after internal coordination:

1) Period inclusivity: the SOC 2 Type II report for Jul 1, 2025 - Dec 31, 2025 is inclusive of all activity on Dec 31, 2025 (any timestamp on that date is in-scope).

2) Point-in-time evidence we will deliver by Thu, 08 Jan 2026 17:00 PT:
   - idp_users_dec31_235959_utc.csv (Identity provider user export)
   - acl_snapshot_dec31_235959_utc.json (ACL/role bindings)
   - infra_state_dec31_235959_utc.tfstate (infrastructure state)
   - authlog_dec31_235900-235959_utc.log (auth/log slice)
   - jira_changes_dec31_window.pdf (change tickets / approvals)
   All artifacts will be bundled as a tar.gz with a manifest and SHA256 checksums.

3) Maintenance windows: we had a scheduled restart for an internal worker queue on Dec 31 between 02:05-02:10 UTC to apply non-impacting patches. We will include the Jira entry (JIR-4821) and a short paragraph in our bridge letter confirming the sequencing and that controls were restored immediately after the window.

4) Format: Tara/manifest + checksums — Teresa, please confirm that is acceptable; if the auditor prefers individual uploads to a secure dropbox instead, let us know.

Attachments included: Redwood-bridge-letter-template.docx (draft) — we'll update it with JIR-4821 and the artifact list prior to shipment.

If that meets your expectations we'll push the bundle tomorrow and share the Drive link + encrypted password over a separate channel.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Sales Engineering, Redwood Inference
[attachment: Redwood-bridge-letter-template.docx]
